messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: starting staged rollout: service=model-server image=redwood/model-server:v3.4.0 -> traffic=25% region=prod-usw2 window=30m
maria.chen: saw a small spike in 5xxs at 1815001252, p95 latency also up ~40ms. Not huge but trending.
sre-oncall: looking at the dashboard now — error rate jumped 0.6% -> 3.2% over 3m for model-server-prod-usw2, traces show upstream timeouts.
devin: can we pause the rollout and reroute traffic back to v3.3.8? we should avoid a wider blast.
ali.khan: i'm on it, can someone hold off on manual revert if deploy-bot has an auto-rollback? want a clean handoff.
deploy-bot: auto-rollback check: error_budget_burn > 0.5 AND sustained_errors > 2m -> triggering automated rollback to last-stable tag=v3.3.8. Initiating rollback in 30s.
patrick: ok team — i'll draft comms for support/product. @support-bot please prefill a customer-facing note and hold until rollback completes.
support-bot: Draft ready: "We observed elevated errors in API requests for model inference in US-West. We are rolling back to a stable version and monitoring. ETA: 15m." (will post to #support after confirmation).
maria.chen: alias: logs show connection reset from the new model worker pool — could be a kernel param or NVIDIA driver mismatch. filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4219
ali.khan: running manual rollback command just in case auto fails:
```
ci-ops rollback --env prod --service model-server --to v3.3.8 --reason "auto rollback triggered, health regressions"
```

sre-oncall: manual command looked good, but i'll let deploy-bot finish rollback first. watching for red/green.
deploy-bot: rollback started -> scaling down v3.4.0, scaling up v3.3.8, traffic shifting to previous stable. progress: 40%
devin: pinging infra to check NV driver diffs in the new pool, tagging @ali.khan for kernel checks.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. all services back to v3.3.8, health checks passing, p95 latency back to baseline, errors reduced.
patrick: posting to #support and #product now. Summary: staged rollout of v3.4.0 caused increased upstream timeouts; auto-rollback triggered and completed; root cause investigation under INF-4219; change window update and release notes will be amended.
maria.chen: recommend we block v3.4.0 from further rollouts until we patch driver/kernel mismatch. also add a canary smoke test for upstream connections in the release pipeline.
devin: agreed. I'll add a pin rule to deployment policy so v3.4.0 cannot be re-deployed until CIDR/driver checks pass.
patrick: good. action items: INF-4219 (root cause), add smoke test to CI, update release notes + changelog entry, notify customers if impacted. Posting follow-up in the release doc. :white_check_mark:
ali.khan: file ownership noted. i'll coordinate with infra tomorrow during change window to validate the fix.
sre-oncall: closing thread, marking incident as mitigated; will reopen if metrics re-blip. :eyes:
